At bounded eigenvalue parameter the fast inverse is O(1/L), so Schur reduction gives convergence with multiplicity to the compressed slow block; the other S eigenvalues diverge left. value.rationale: The construction gives a minimal counterexample to predicting local coexistence stability from aggregate pairwise interactions alone when the two life-stage rates are fast but unequal. Its weighted slow matrix explains why the contrast disappears under equal rates, and the three-species cycle gives strict opposite verdicts already at a certified finite rate instead of a formal singular limit only. This is useful for interpreting aggregate stability diagnostics in this stage-exchange model, not a calibrated ecological prediction or a global persistence result.
